characters.name: Doug Heffernan
characters.description: Acrofatic: Shown to be surprisingly athletic in short bursts, such as when dominating a large group of children in football, or when playing squash with Deacon (though the latter results in aVomit Discretion Shotdue to overexertion.)Arthur:...for a man of his size, he moves on cats' feet. Berserk Button: Arthur's crazy antics easily get on Doug's nerves. Big Eater: Nearly the crux of his entire character. Big Fun: Fun-loving, funny, and definitely big. Book Dumb: Considers books "brutal."

characters.name: Carrie Heffernan
characters.description: Beauty Is Bad: She's pretty but also quite mean. Buxom Beauty Standard: Carrie's big boobs are a major reason why she's theHot Wife to Doug's Ugly Guyand he certainly appreciates that. But this getsSubvertedin the episode where she tries to seduce one of her bosses by unbuttoning her top, but he totallyIgnores The Fanservice. Control Freak: Comes to a head when Carrie bans Doug from changing his cologne. The Cynic: To contrast with Doug's optimism. "Thanks, Man" is a full episode exploration of their differing views on the world. Delinquent: As a teen, she happily participated in a carjacking. She laughs as she reminisces about it, much to Doug's horror.

characters.name: Arthur Spooner
characters.description: Abusive Parents: Sometimes played seriously, such as his father forcing him to Trick-or-Treat until his feet bled in order to acquire food for the family. Amazingly Embarrassing Parents: Both has and is one; his father loudly and openly heckled him during his church choir solo as a child. Berserk Button: He's a command center of them. Halloween, Larry King, Charlie Brown, a neighbor's wreath, a hogged armrest... Boyfriend-Blocking Dad: Hid correspondence from Carrie's boyfriend when she was in high school. Occassionally played for laughs when he attempts to block her husband.Arthur:Why do you need birth control? Does he touch you!? Bratty Food Demand: In an episode where Doug learns to make demands of Carrie vicariously through Arthur, he's shown bursting in on her multiple times while screaming "I WANT (FOOD)!"

characters.name: Deacon Palmer
characters.description: Affair Partner Denial: This is Deacon first line of defence when Doug walks, by chance, into the Chinese restaurant where his best friend is having an intimate dinner with another woman.noteHe maintains Angie is an ex from a long time ago and they're just catching up as old friends.As his wife Carrie is best friends with Deacon's wife Kelly, this puts Doug into an excruciatingly awkward position. Foot-Dragging Divorcee: Hesitates to sign the divorce papers when his wife wants a separation. Hidden Depths: Served in the National Guard, where he learned to sew and saved a man's life, and volunteers as a Big Brother on the weekends, much to Doug's perturbence. Not Actually His Child: His dad's suspicions that Deacon's the result of his mother's cheating ultimately led to a break between them. Parental Fashion Veto: Ultimately fails to veto Kirby's Powerpuff Girls costume on Halloween.

characters.name: Spencer "Spence" Olchin
characters.description: Bully Magnet: Bullied by his friends, his mom, children, Tivo... Caught with Your Pants Down: Doug's dad caught him masturbating in the Heffernan bathroom in high school, setting off a lifelong dislike. Disappeared Dad: His dad left early in his life. Dream-Crushing Handicap: Was beginning a promising shuffleboard career before being psychologically crippled by walking in on his mom and his coach in her bed. Embarrassed by a Child: After discovering his peanut allergy, Deacon's son uses it to mock and bully him.

characters.name: Danny Heffernan
characters.description: Alcoholic Parent: Spence threatens to tempt his mom back into alcoholism after Danny flirts with Spence's mom in order to manipulate him. The Dandy: In one episode, he gets his teeth whitened, his hair bleached, and has his skin treated with acid. Emasculated Cuckold: Babysits the child his ex concieved while cheating on him. Heterosexual Life-Partners: Has this kind of relationship with Spence in later seasons to such an extent that they share a bedroom, car, and bank account. Nerdy Inhaler: One of the traits he shares with Spence.

characters.name: Holly Shumpert
characters.description: Babies Ever After: Her cameo in the last episode features her near the end of her pregnancy and alone. Dumb Blonde: Easily the dumbest female character on the show. Extreme Doormat: Pushed around by Arthur; downright terrified of Carrie. Even Doug managed to boss her around during the brief stint she stayed with them. Really Gets Around: Implied to have frequent drunken one-night stands on top of her fleeting relationships. Sex for Services: Tries to pay off her landlord with sex. Apparantly plans to sleep her way out of her next traffic ticket.
